walkthrough.title: Start the journey to becoming an expert
walkthrough.summary: You are already here — that is the first task done
walkthrough.body:
Every task in this list teaches one thing Asyar can do that most people never find.

You do not tick these off by hand. Each task watches how you actually use Asyar and completes itself the moment you do the thing for real. Tasks you have already been doing for weeks are already ticked — the list only ever shows you what is genuinely left.

## To complete the task

Open the Walkthrough. Done.

walkthrough.title: Keep a favorite ready
walkthrough.summary: Favorite an application or command you use often
walkthrough.body:
Favorites stay at the top when the search is empty, ahead of Asyar's automatic usage ranking. They can be applications or commands, and typed searches still rank by relevance.

## To complete the task

1. Select any application or command in the launcher.
2. Open **Actions** with **⌘K**.
3. Choose **Add to favorites**.
4. Clear the search to see it at the top.
